experiments.scope: The exact blake3-r2-prefix-v1 target, on the instance the harness hashes: one chunk, counter 0, flags 11. One trial per organizer seed runs the search of proof.md 9.1 on 256 batches (1,792 outer steps) drawn from the seed: the whole-class sampler, the packed step CO, the exact outer filter of Section 8 for S, the s-pattern pre-check of 9.7, step 2 by the one-success slot of 9.8 (the selector J from five bits of the raw eighth word, the envelope of the mask of (1), one row and one leaf path, so at most one root per solver step, with the guards (a)-(g) of 9.4, (G7), Lemma J0 and the guards at positions 25 and 29), the certificate of step 3 for every root, and the operation counter of Section 11 used as a ledger. The returned pair is built by step CT on the trial's first passing outer step (its first outer step if none passes), with the one value of E1.c1 for which the counter word that step CT forces is t = 0 (Lemma IP): a 55-byte message and a 63-byte message. Every trial is returned. No BLAKE3 library is imported; the pair is built from the lines of steps CO and CT. SHAKE-256 from the standard library only expands the seed into the batch words. The organizer recomputes both digests. The slot of 9.8 is the program's default; its option --no-slot32, not used by this experiment, runs the complete traversal of 9.4. proof.md Section 13 (The submitted program) describes the program and its limits.
experiments.hypothesis: For every trial the two complete 2-round digests (counter 0, flags 11) agree on digest words 0, 2, 5 and 7, the 128 masked bits. This is exact: after the first half of round 2 the two states differ only in Y3 and Y11, the only differing message word of the diagonal step is w5, and none of these enters diagonals 0 and 2, which alone give digest words 0, 2, 5 and 7. The observations (14, under the organizer's limit of 16) are the program's own counts, untrusted and not recomputed by the organizer: outer_steps, passes, solver_steps, slot_rows (solver steps whose slot named a row of T that was set up), solver_units (the Section 11 ledger of steps 2 and 3), solver_units_max (against the cap 8,912 of 9.8), over_cap, units (the outer steps' units plus solver_units), roots (joint roots found), roots_t0 (roots whose certificate passed Q* and t = 0), certified (roots that pass every test of step 3, a full collision), verify_fail, halted and pair_step. Expected per trial from the exact shares: about 1.8 passes (SHARE/2^64 = 0.000991 of the steps), about 0.44 solver steps (0.25 per pass), about 65 units per outer step (the Section 11 ledger at the nominal shares is 65.34 with steps 2 and 3 at the cap), and almost always 0 roots. A root on this instance is certified only if its forced counter word is 0, about 2^-32 of the roots if that word is uniform; the run is not evidence of attack cost. In the participant's local run of 64 seeds: 1.72 passes, 0.45 solver steps (0.20 with a row set up) and 64.58 units per outer step on average, 5,829 solver units per solver step on average, solver_units_max at most 8,044, no root.

experiments.scope: The exact blake3-r2-prefix-v1 target, on the instance the harness hashes: one chunk, counter 0, flags 11. Per organizer seed the trial of the half-collision experiment is run in full (the same pipeline with the slot of proof.md 9.8, the same counts and outer step). Then, keeping the seven outer words of that outer step, the members of the class of Lemma Q are taken in order from the step's own member, at most 131,072 of them; each member gives a new outer step by step CO and its pair by step CT with t = 0, and the search stops at the first pair whose residual has a zero low byte in digest word 1. Failed trials are returned as null pairs. The number of members tried is returned as the observation tries, beside the pipeline's observations. The observation units here is the trial's units plus member_units, the member loop at one unit per 32-bit word operation (a rotation 3): 1,002 per try (member_y, the 77 lines of step CO, omega, step CT with t = 0, two 2-round compressions, the residual test, the loop), 3 per next member from the second try, 1 for the first. member_units is computed as tries times this charge, not counted inside the loop; the loop computes the parts that do not depend on the member (the lines of step CO that do not read Y4, the round-1 column step, the round-1 diagonal G calls on words 12 to 15) once per trial, so the charge is not less than what it executes.
experiments.hypothesis: Every returned pair agrees on 136 digest bits (counter 0, flags 11): the 128 bits of the half-collision and the low byte of digest word 1. If that byte of the residual were an independent uniform byte in every member, 256 members would be tried on average; the members are tried in order and are not independent, so the mean of one run is not a measured rate; in the participant's local run of 64 seeds the mean was 367.5 (7 to 1,599), and units averaged 270.61 per outer step of the trial, of which 206.08 is the member loop. Nearly all seeds return a pair within the 131,072 members. It does not test a heuristic, measure a 128-bit hit rate, or show attack cost. All observations are the program's own counts, untrusted and not recomputed by the organizer.
